items.name: ATG Signal
items.description: Identify top-performing social media content and compare performance between reporting periods.
runtimeRequirements: A modern Windows, macOS or Linux browser for the browser version
Windows 10 or Windows 11 on a 64-bit x86 system for the Windows native beta
macOS 11 or later on Apple Silicon for the macOS native beta
items.internetAfterInstallation: Not required for analysis or report generation
permissions: Read files explicitly selected by the user
items.privacy: Your selected files are processed on this device. OpenATG does not receive or store their contents.
privacyStatements: The browser version also processes selected files locally.
items.offlineAvailability: Processing is local after the native application is installed. The browser version processes selected files locally after the page has loaded.
releaseNotes: Includes top-performing post analysis, week-on-week comparison, and local Excel and Word report generation.
